# Epigram

> Open-source, free, and AI-powered news in short.

Epigram is an open-source, AI-powered news app that delivers bite-sized news,
real-time updates, and in-depth analysis. It summarizes trusted sources with AI
so readers get the information that matters without the overwhelm.

## About

- Personalized news feed curated from user-selected topics
- AI-powered summaries and in-depth analysis (deep dive) of articles
- News sourced from reputable providers worldwide
- Responsive, user-friendly interface with add-to-home-screen support

## Tech Stack

- Next.js (App Router) with React
- Exa for news content retrieval
- AI SDK with OpenAI (gpt-4o-mini) for summaries and analysis
- Mediastack for news data
- Upstash Redis for caching and rate limiting
